SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH recovered AS (
  UPDATE sales_prod.scheduled_followups sf
  SET retry_count = sf.retry_count + 1,
      status = CASE
        WHEN sf.retry_count + 1 >= GREATEST(COALESCE(sales_prod.get_system_config_int('followup.max-retries', 3), 3), 1) THEN 'FAILED'
        ELSE 'PENDING'
      END,
      processed_at = CASE
        WHEN sf.retry_count + 1 >= GREATEST(COALESCE(sales_prod.get_system_config_int('followup.max-retries', 3), 3), 1) THEN now()
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      last_error_at = now(),
      error_msg = CASE
        WHEN sf.retry_count + 1 >= GREATEST(COALESCE(sales_prod.get_system_config_int('followup.max-retries', 3), 3), 1) THEN 'processing_timeout_failed'
        ELSE 'processing_timeout_requeued'
      END
  WHERE sf.status = 'PROCESSING'
    AND COALESCE(sf.processed_at, sf.created_at, now()) < now() - make_interval(mins => GREATEST(COALESCE(sales_prod.get_system_config_int('followup.processing-timeout-minutes', 45), 45), 5))
  RETURNING sf.id
)
SELECT f.*
FROM (
  SELECT set_config('search_path', 'sales_prod, public, extensions', true) AS value
) AS sp
CROSS JOIN LATERAL sales_prod.claim_due_followups($1::integer + (length(sp.value) * 0) + (SELECT count(*)::integer * 0 FROM recovered)) AS f;
